class.name: CgameProfiledMutex
class.brief_description: Recursive mutex that records lock contention statistics.
class.description: [CgameProfiledMutex] behaves like [Mutex] (it can be locked repeatedly by one thread) and records the number of acquisitions, contended acquisitions, wait time, hold time and the last owner thread. Mutexes created with [method create] join a global registry that [method report] lists sorted by total wait time. When [CgameTrace] is enabled, contended waits show up as [code]wait:name[/code] scopes in the category [code]lock[/code]. [method sync_point] times arbitrary blocking calls such as GPU read-backs and flags those slower than a threshold, which exposes CPU/GPU synchronization stalls. [b]Note:[/b] Like [Mutex], a [CgameProfiledMutex] must not be destroyed while locked.

method.name: clear_registry
method.description: Removes all mutexes from the registry and clears the recorded sync points. The mutexes themselves keep working.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a named mutex and adds it to the registry.

method.name: get_long_sync_threshold_ms
method.description: Returns the duration in milliseconds from which a sync point counts as long.

method.name: lock
method.description: Locks the mutex, blocking if another thread holds it, and records wait time when contended.

method.name: long_syncs
method.description: Returns the names of sync points that exceeded the long-sync threshold at least once.

method.name: report
method.description: Returns [method stats] of every registered mutex, sorted by total wait time (then by hold time).

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets the statistics of this mutex.

method.name: set_long_sync_threshold_ms
method.description: Sets the duration in milliseconds from which a sync point counts as long. The default is [code]2.0[/code].

method.name: stats
method.description: Returns [code]{name, acquisitions, contended, total_wait_ms, max_wait_ms, total_hold_ms, max_hold_ms, owner_thread_id}[/code].

method.name: sync_point
method.description: Calls [param callable], records its duration under [param name] and returns its result.

method.name: sync_report
method.description: Returns [code]{name, count, total_ms, max_ms, long_count}[/code] for every recorded sync point, sorted by total time.

method.name: try_lock
method.description: Locks the mutex if it is free and returns [code]true[/code]; returns [code]false[/code] immediately otherwise.

method.name: unlock
method.description: Unlocks the mutex and records the hold time when the outermost lock is released.

members.member: Display name used in reports and trace scopes.
